identity.headline: One job in. One inspectable result out.
identity.explanation: Clervo is designed to route a bounded job across models, data, and runtime, then return the result with evidence, cost, and a receipt.

products.label: Research
allowedClaims: Raw cited Search is publicly callable through a bounded free sample and an exact 0.006 USDC Base x402 offer.
The production edge returned live normalized results and citations while direct product access to the origin remained denied.
The private Search path returned one useful result after one bounded owner-funded x402 settlement.
An exact replay returned the same receipt without another authorization, execution, or charge.

products.label: AI
allowedClaims: Bounded AI chat requests expose an exact request-derived Base USDC x402 quote through the protected production edge.
The production origin returned a stable 402 challenge for gpt-5.6-luna while direct product access remained denied.
Only currently qualified exact routes are eligible; unsupported or expired routes fail closed.

products.label: Secure Sandbox
allowedClaims: Bounded one-shot Node.js execution is publicly callable through an exact 0.12 USDC Base x402 or MPP offer.
The production origin executed useful output in the qualified gVisor runner, replayed the same result without another execution, and left no runtime resources.
The current release is intentionally single-node and fails closed when its bounded capacity is unavailable.
prohibitedClaims: Arbitrary container images or network access

products.label: Multi-chain RPC
allowedClaims: The RPC core is privately qualified.

products.label: Prediction Intelligence
allowedClaims: Derived Prediction Intelligence is publicly callable through exact Base USDC x402 offers from 0.002 to 0.003 USDC.
Qualified zero-cost pdata supply covers Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, and Limitless with CC BY 4.0 attribution and Clervo transformation.
Direct venue adapters with unresolved commercial permission remain disabled and fail closed.
Two bounded owner-funded production operations each settled for exactly 0.002 USDC, returned useful fresh pdata-attributed results, and replayed without another authorization or charge.
prohibitedClaims: Unrelated-customer demand or externally repeated proof
Raw pdata proxy or raw feed redistribution
Commercial permission for unresolved direct venue adapters

products.label: Crypto Intelligence
allowedClaims: The Crypto Intelligence core is privately qualified and read-only.

blockrun.reason: No volatile count, price, availability, quality, or savings claim renders until its primary-source observation is current and reviewable.
